reviews.review_title: A SIMPLE BUT EFFECTIVE PSYCHOLOGICAL VR
reviews.review_description:
Between Floors offers a simple yet highly promising concept for fans of observational and psychological horror games. The slightest change can seem suspicious, and every mistake forces you to restart your progress. It is an intriguing experience that proves particularly addictive for players who enjoy putting their memory and eye for detail to the test.
Not to mention the intense pressure of having to make a choice within a very limited timeframe—and before getting caught! Excellent.

reviews.review_title: Spot the Anomaly in VR. Quickly...
reviews.review_description:
Between Floors is a clever psychological horror game that perfectly blends observation and quick decision-making! Inspired by the micro-genre of The Exit 8, this VR gem tasks you with spotting subtle environmental anomalies as you ascend floors. The tall guy lurking in the background? Never the anomaly—anything can change! But he is coming to get you.
The concept is brilliantly simple: study a scene, then move up and quickly identify what’s different. With 14 correct answers needed to advance, the pressure mounts fast! VR enhances the experience with crystal-clear vision and an oppressive atmosphere that keeps you on edge. A fresh, original horror experience that’s both fun and thought-provoking. A must-play for puzzle and horror fans! 🎮✨
